jd_template:
{company} is hiring a {role} in {location}.

What you will do:
- look after several ongoing pieces of work from start to finish
- train new colleagues as they join
- report progress to the people who depend on your work

What we need from you:
- experience training or guiding someone new to the work
- experience handling a complaint from someone you work for
- experience presenting your work to a large group

stories.title: Trained two new starters in their first month
stories.body:
**Situation.** Two new starters joined in the same week, and the usual trainer had just left.

**Task.** I was asked to get them working on their own within a month.

**Action.** I wrote a one-page guide to the tasks they would do most, sat with each of them for an hour a day in the first week, and then moved to a short daily question time.

**Result.** Both were handling their own work by the end of the third week, and the guide was kept for later starters.

stories.title: Reorganised the shared files
stories.body:
**Situation.** The shared folders had grown over years, and people spent a long time finding the current version of a document.

**Task.** I volunteered to sort them out.

**Action.** I agreed a simple folder plan with my colleagues, moved the files over two evenings, and archived anything untouched for a year.

**Result.** People stopped asking where things were, and the number of duplicate copies fell by about half.

untold_stories.title: Sent a weekly note on a shared backlog
untold_stories.body:
**Situation.** Three colleagues relied on a backlog of requests I worked through, and they often asked where each one stood.

**Task.** I wanted them to know without having to ask.

**Action.** Every Friday I sent a short note listing what I had finished that week, what came next and what was waiting on someone else.

**Result.** Within a month the questions about where things stood had mostly stopped, and one colleague began using the note to plan their own week.

directives: After the coach names the requirements none of your notes covers, ask it whether one of them, by name, matters.
Prepare for two requirements: the one your story that is not in your notes fits, and "experience handling a complaint from someone you work for".
